In detail

Alna is one of Oslo's 15 official bydeler (city boroughs). Oslo kommune's own police-sourced Statistikkbanken data recorded 3,452 reported offences with their place of occurrence here in 2024, across a population of 50,358 residents — a rate of 6,855 offences per 100,000 residents, roughly 0.7× the citywide average, below it. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central or nightlife/shopping-heavy bydel can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential bydel can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Oslo — real Oslo kommune Statistikkbanken figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Alna safe?

Wandroz currently rates Alna in Oslo, Norway as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Oslo, Norway, based on Oslo kommune's Statistikkbanken 2024 reported-offence figures. This source has no time-of-day breakdown, so this is one overall level rather than a separately measured day and night figure — see the note on this page before treating the day/night badges as independently measured.

Does Alna's rating cover night-time safety specifically?

Not separately. Oslo kommune's Statistikkbanken 2024 reported-offence figures publishes one figure per zone with no time-of-day split, so Alna's day and night badges show the same underlying level rather than an independently measured night figure. Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.

Is Alna a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Alna's rating is a useful general indicator, but this data is normalised against registered residents, not visitor footfall — busy tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher without that meaning elevated risk for a visitor passing through. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

What official data is Alna's rating based on?

Oslo kommune's Statistikkbanken 2024 reported-offence figures, covering Alna's real administrative boundary. This is a genuine official dataset, not a qualitative judgment or press research — see the methodology page for the exact figures, the year they cover, and how the rate is calculated.
